what: src/reuse/harvest_variants.py monkeypatches variants.blocks (was `getattr(model,'model',model).layers` only) to reuse interv.HookedRunner._find_blocks, a generic model/transformer/gpt_neox/language_model x layers/h/blocks/decoder search. Fixes AttributeError: 'GPTNeoXForCausalLM' object has no attribute 'layers' (pythia-410m) and the equivalent for Bloom (transformer.h).
impact: No formula/schema change; only how the block list is located. Verified pythia-410m and bloomz-560m harvest+battery OK.

what: A second, deeper instance of the same problem: variants.weight_fingerprint and harvest_variants.block_vmins both hardcoded block.self_attn.o_proj / block.mlp.down_proj (raised AttributeError: 'GPTNeoXLayer' object has no attribute 'self_attn'). Added _attn_mlp_out_modules() reusing interv.lesion_module_names (ARCH_LESION_MODULES + leaf-name fallback) plus a leaf-name submodule search, and monkeypatched variants.weight_fingerprint to use it; block_vmins edited directly to use it too.
impact: Same attn-out/mlp-out tensors as before for Llama-family (o_proj/down_proj unchanged); now also resolves GPT-NeoX (attention.dense/mlp.dense_4h_to_h) and Bloom (self_attention.dense/mlp.dense_4h_to_h). Formula (sha256 over embed/lm_head/layer0/mid/last/final-norm; Gram of [attn_out|mlp_out]) unchanged.

what: src/reuse/harvest_variants.py monkeypatches variants.load_parent to always load with attn_implementation='eager' (was 'sdpa' by default for the HG branch). Fixes: GPTNeoForCausalLM does not support SDPA ('load your model with attn_implementation="eager"'). Matches tierB.run_tag's own battery, which already force-switches every arm to eager post-load (model.set_attn_implementation('eager')) regardless of tag -- so this makes the harvest consistent with the battery it feeds rather than diverging from it.
impact: No behavioural difference expected for archs that already ran the battery under eager; only the harvest-phase forward pass now also runs eager instead of sdpa for all HG tags.

what: Same load_parent wrapper repairs a tokenizer with NEITHER pad_token NOR eos_token NOR bos_token registered (PleIAs/Pleias-1.2b-Preview ships an empty special_tokens_map.json / bare tokenizer_config.json even though config.json/generation_config.json carry bos_token_id=1, eos_token_id=2). Restores eos/bos straight from model.config (real, verified vocab ids), then falls back through load_parent's own 'pad=eos' rule, then the literal [PAD] token already in the vocab, and only mints a new special token as a last resort. Without the bos/eos repair, tierB.run_tag's own contentless() ('bos = tok.bos_token_id if ... else tok.eos_token_id; ids=[int(bos)]') raised TypeError: int() argument ... not 'NoneType' -- a battery-side symptom of the same missing-special-tokens root cause discovered only after the harvest-only fix, not a second architecture bug.
impact: padding_side left untouched (right for p_harvest/c11/n5, left for dec_harvest, exactly as the surrounding code already sets it).

what: src/tierB.py build_arm() now also does `import harvest_variants` (in addition to `import variants`). Reason: external_harvest() is the only place that originally imported harvest_variants, so the monkeypatches (cf1-cf4) applied only when the harvest step itself ran in that process. On a resumed `--repo` invocation where results/confirm_harvest/<tag>/DONE already exists (e.g. a battery-only retry after a battery-side crash), external_harvest() is skipped entirely and build_arm() -- called only via run_tag() -- was loading through the UNPATCHED variants module, reproducing the exact TypeError/AttributeError this fix set out to remove. Re-importing an already-imported module is a sys.modules no-op; no formula/battery logic changed.
impact: Discovered via HG__PleIAs--Pleias-1.2b-Preview: 1st attempt failed at battery's contentless() (int(None)); patched load_parent for bos/eos, RE-RAN, harvest step was skipped (already DONE) so the SAME error reproduced identically; added this import; 3rd attempt: OK.

what: Two A_prompt cross-check outliers observed while confirming, neither caused by cf1-cf5/cf8 and neither fixed (out of the declared bug scope, and independent of batch size -- the layer-0 hidden state is one token's embedding row, which does not depend on what else is in its batch): HG__bigscience--bloomz-560m (median rel err ~125% vs the substrate's own A_prompt) and HG__deepseek-ai--deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct (median rel err ~71%) both show near-zero correlation with the substrate's array at layer 0 (embeddings of the LAST real prompt token) but 0.55-0.97 correlation at the last layer -- i.e. a different last-token / render text, not a numeric bug. bloomz has no tok.chat_template, so variants.render()'s documented 'ref' fallback (stock chat template, no system prompt) becomes plain `text + "\n"`; deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct DOES have a chat_template, so its mismatch has the same signature but a different concrete cause (not diagnosed further under the time box). Registered numbers (W1-W8 etc.) are computed from a LIVE forward pass inside Battery.ensure_base, not from the saved array, so this does not corrupt either battery result -- only the stored A_prompt.npy vs the OTHER (sibling) pipeline's own array for these two tags.
impact: bloomz-560m and deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct: registered battery numbers (both status OK, all sanity checks pass) are unaffected; the cross-check is flagged as an outlier for the coordinator to reconcile against the sibling pipeline's render convention if it matters downstream.

what: Per coordinator instruction (time-boxed to 04:50 UTC): re-harvested HG__deepseek-ai--deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct with CFG['batch_prompt'] 8->4 and CFG['dec_batch'] 32->8 instead of raising the harvest's 4.5 GB VRAM cap. CFG in src/reuse/harvest_variants.py now reads both from env (CONFIRMFIX_BATCH_PROMPT, CONFIRMFIX_DEC_BATCH), defaulting to the original 8/32 when unset, so every other tag's arrays are produced at the ORIGINAL batch sizes; only this one invocation set CONFIRMFIX_BATCH_PROMPT=4 CONFIRMFIX_DEC_BATCH=8. The partial harvest dir from the two prior 4.5GB-cap OOM attempts (results/confirm_harvest/HG__deepseek-ai--deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct, never reached DONE) was removed before this retry so no stale array survives at a mixed batch shape. Harvest completed in 133s (previously OOM'd inside dec_harvest every time at batch_prompt=8/dec_batch=32); battery then ran normally and reported status OK.
impact: bf16 batch-shape sensitivity: HG__deepseek-ai--deepseek-coder-1.3b-instruct's own A_prompt/A_dec/etc. arrays were computed at batch_prompt=4, dec_batch=8, a different (smaller) batch grouping than every other confirm-harvest tag (batch_prompt=8, dec_batch=32). This can shift its own values by bf16 rounding-order noise (accepted per coordinator: it only affects this one held-out checkpoint's internally-consistent numbers; every contrast the battery computes stays within this single pass/checkpoint). No other tag's harvest was re-run or touched by this change; the 4.5 GB VRAM cap itself was left untouched.

what: HG__huihui-ai--Huihui-gemma-3-270m-it-abliterated AND HG__unsloth--gemma-3-270m-it's harvested A_prompt.npy contains 18 +-inf entries out of ~3.1M (float16 saturates at 65504; Gemma3's late-layer residual-stream norms are known to run very large). The substrate's own A_prompt for the same tag has zero inf entries. The 27-file schema fixes A_prompt's dtype at float16, so this is not something this fix changes; flagging only.
impact: 18/3,112,960 elements (5.8e-6) saturate to inf in the stored array; the live battery forward pass (float32 internally) is unaffected -- HG__huihui-ai--Huihui-gemma-3-270m-it-abliterated's registered numbers are all finite and passed every sanity check.
